overall: The AG found no evidence the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by deliberating serially about a Conservation Commission reappointment, crediting a member's account that her call only covered remote participation. A separate name-calling allegation was declined as outside the law. No order issued.

allegations.summary: Alleged a quorum of the Board deliberated by text and phone, outside a posted meeting, about a Conservation Commission reappointment before the July 29 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Based on the lack of evidence of deliberation outside of a meeting in this instance, we find that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Alleged a Board member called the complainant a derogatory name in an email to the Town Administrator.
allegations.key_passage: We note that, even if true, this allegation would not constitute a violation of G.L. c. 30A, §§ 18-25.
